diagnosis: `induction der` cannot eliminate the typing derivation while its context index is the non-variable expression `[]`. Generalize that index to a fresh context and retain an equality showing it is empty; induction and `grind` can then use the equality to eliminate impossible variable cases and establish the recursive cases.
proof_body:
by
  generalize hΓ : ([] : Context Var) = Γ at der
  induction der <;> grind [cases Term.Value, cases Red]
